policy_semantics.issue: Diagnosis may be presented normally when the final higher reliability criterion is satisfied.
policy_semantics.qualify: Diagnosis may be presented with explicit reliability qualification when it falls between the final lower and higher criteria.
policy_semantics.withhold: Generated fault diagnosis is not presented as sufficiently reliable for operational decision support when the lower criterion is not met.

definitions.coverage: Proportion of eligible diagnoses with predicted reliability at or above a candidate threshold.
definitions.selective_risk: Proportion of accepted diagnoses that are diagnostically incorrect.
